title: Ding
blurb: Bell-clear, instantly understood, endlessly applicable. This is the atom from which every other notification sound has been built. One clean ding covers an idea arriving, a lift reaching your floor, an order coming up, and a point landing squarely in an argument. There is no cleverness here and no branding, and the sound does not want anything from you, so it has outlived cleverer competitors. When a moment needs marking and nothing elaborate will do, reach for this. The most honest file in the catalogue. It dings. That is the complete feature set.
origin: One clean bell ding, the universal alert.
